# Demo MADC Panel Files

These files provide a tiny species panel entry for testing the HapApp UI,
panel configuration path validation, and the MADC workflow.

Use this raw MADC fixture when demoing the panel:

`vendor/HapApp_utils/data/demo_panel/demo_raw_MADC.csv`

The demo panel covers only the first marker from the larger bundled
`species_MADC.csv` fixture. It is not a production allele database.
